blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines– Memories of her historic Olympic gold medal in Tokyo came flooding back for Hidilyn Diaz-Naranjo as she served as one of the torchbearers for the Aichi-Nagoya 20th Asian Games on Thursday. After completing her segment of the relay, Diaz-Naranjo was met by Philippine Olympic Committee President Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino. The 4-foot-11 weightlifter from Zamboanga City made history at the pandemic-delayed Tokyo Olympics in 2021 by winning the Philippines’ first Olympic gold medal, ending a 97-year wait for the country’s first gold.
